rules.LIB_MOVE: Reader moves one cell on a shortest path to the help desk.
rules.LIB_QUEUE: Arriving reader joins the service queue for the next step.
rules.LIB_SERVE: Open desk serves at most one previously queued reader.
rules.LIB_READ: Reader without a help request keeps reading.
rules.WORK_MOVE: Worker moves to counter or workstation along a shortest path.
rules.WORK_QUEUE: Arriving worker joins loan or return queue for the next step.
rules.WORK_LOAN: Storekeeper lends one available drill to a queued worker.
rules.WORK_RETURN: Storekeeper accepts one returned drill before any loan.
rules.WORK_JOB: Worker holding a drill completes one work unit at workstation.
